projectDescription: AgentNode is an AI-powered SMS follow-up platform for real estate agents that automatically texts dormant leads, keeps conversations going, and hands off to the agent the moment a human response is needed.
keyFeatures: AI-drafted personalised SMS follow-ups for dormant leads
Automatic conversation handling with human escalation guardrails
CSV contact import with column mapping and deduplication
Campaign engine for ongoing automated outreach to contact groups
Inbox with Needs You, Conversations, and Bookings columns
publicApiSurface: Reach Out (one-off text to one or more contacts)
Campaign tabs: Overview, Recent Messages, Contacts, Context
Settings: account, phone number, messaging preferences
